choices.why: This low, boxy off-white fabric sofa with dark legs is the calmest and most Japandi option, and the chaise can sit along the right wall without crowding the room.
At 160x230 cm, this natural jute rug is big enough to sit under the front of the sofa and the coffee table, and its texture warms the dark floor.
This low, round, all-wood table with simple splayed legs is exactly the minimal Japandi piece asked for, with no metal or gold details.
It is the only floor lamp, and its tall rice-paper lantern shape fits the corner beside the sofa and gives soft light.

The ZZ plant gives the greenery and height wanted beside the balcony door; it comes in a plain nursery pot, so it would need repotting into a neutral ceramic one like the beige pot candidate to fully match the request.

answer.why: Off-white fabric, jute, warm wood and rice paper make a short, neutral palette of natural materials that softens the dark floor and white walls, giving the calm, uncluttered Japandi living room the user asked for.
